test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of letter- clusters.

OTG : UPK

YND : EJH
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d8e2325dd532cb20d357a3d9cdde3d052b60dd3bcf38c240829a5f53de6a213.png] ​

**Logic: '6' and '4' are added to the positional value of the first and third **alphabets respectively,** and '4' is subtracted from the positional value of the second alphabet.**

**Given:**

**OTG : UPK →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e87d35b9ae80708e2fd2a8dde813c86d3c344c8cb671af7a365f0fbc1a126b58.png] 

**YND : EJH →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1a2c896436d3d6ae5e604c16150415b448cfef0144e978a9cc740aec8f0cd19.png] 

Checking the given options:

**(1) **CRY : JVU →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfc5f06c06d0c446210cbba9f68bb7629df091c43964f58cfd8b554b114fc47d.png] 

**(2)** SAY : MZB →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6552677deb6fab67d4249ca437a07638d6961115306add210817705331b5b1ac.png] 

**(3) **GHS : MDW →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6e2553a4ac8b1ff72eab0834c1e90e945c94f8fe3be1fa553529ec7f969ee2.png] 

**(4)** AMO : GIK →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b831c06933e0c83a28ead373cef51b7340a7fda1fd5b30b3633a626039f51c7.png] 

Here, **'GHS : MDW'** is similar to the given letter clusters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
